limitations: One policyholder account at one synthetic insurer per App instance. The adjuster, the repair shop and the lender are not accounts: what they do arrives as events.
First-party property claims only: collision, comprehensive and renters personal property. No injury, liability, fault, premiums, bills or quotes.
MCP only: no GUI and no console for the adjuster or the shop.
The App has no timer and no scheduler. Deadlines, expired offers, overdue requests and rental days are computed from the supplied virtual time.
Amounts are task data. The App computes only the sums of its money summary, and a payment is a record: no money moves.
Evidence items are records with no file bytes: resources are not used.
Notifications reach Mail only through the Infra-run sender and Messaging. The App itself delivers nothing.
